intro: Mahatma Gandhi Law College and Sultan-Ul-Uloom College of Law both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded LLM fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.
